warmups.name: Arm Circles
warmups.precautions: Stand tall, arms out at shoulder height;Shoulders down away from ears;Start tiny circles, grow them gradually
warmups.cues: Arms out, small circles;Slowly make circles bigger

warmups.name: Kettlebell Halo
warmups.precautions: Feet hip-width, glutes squeezed, ribs down;Bell circles close around head - elbows in;Head and torso completely still - only arms move
warmups.cues: Ribs down, glutes tight;Circle bell slowly around head;Keep elbows close

warmups.name: Scap Push-up
warmups.precautions: Body in one straight line head-to-heels - hips not sagging or piked (unless Pike);Hands under shoulders, fingers spread;Head neutral - look at floor, not forward
warmups.cues: Body in one straight line;Hands under shoulders;Lower with control, press up

exercises.name: Shoulder Press Machine
exercises.precautions: Feet hip-width, glutes squeezed, ribs down;Wrists straight over elbows as you press;Head moves slightly back then through - no shrugging to ears;Lower to shoulder height with control
exercises.cues: Ribs down, glutes tight;Press straight overhead;Lower slowly to shoulder height

exercises.name: Single-Arm KB Press
exercises.precautions: Feet hip-width, glutes squeezed, ribs down;Wrists straight over elbows as you press;Head moves slightly back then through - no shrugging to ears;Lower to shoulder height with control
exercises.cues: Ribs down, glutes tight;Press straight overhead;Lower slowly to shoulder height

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raise
exercises.precautions: Stand tall, slight bend in elbows that stays fixed;Shoulders down away from ears the whole time;Lift only to shoulder height - thumbs level or slightly down;No swinging from hips - torso completely still
exercises.cues: Slight bend in elbows;Lift to shoulder height only;Lower slowly, no swinging

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.precautions: Back flat on pad, chest tall;Soft bend in elbows that stays fixed;Shoulders down and back - not rolled forward;Move from the shoulder joint only
exercises.cues: Chest tall, soft elbows;Open arms wide with control;Squeeze shoulder blades together

exercises.name: Pike Push-up
exercises.precautions: Body in one straight line head-to-heels - hips not sagging or piked (unless Pike);Hands under shoulders, fingers spread;Head neutral - look at floor, not forward;Only arms bend - torso stays rigid like a plank
exercises.cues: Hips high, head between arms;Bend elbows, head toward floor;Press floor away to straighten

exercises.name: DB Shoulder Press
exercises.precautions: Feet hip-width, glutes squeezed, ribs down;Wrists straight over elbows as you press;Elbows slightly in front of body - not flared wide;Head neutral - no shrugging shoulders to ears
exercises.cues: Press dumbbells straight up;Lower slowly to shoulder height;Keep ribs down the whole time

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.precautions: Stand tall beside the cable, shoulders down away from ears;Slight bend in elbow that stays fixed;Arm stays in line with body - slightly in front;No swinging from hips - torso completely still
exercises.cues: Pulleys at hand height to start;Lift to shoulder height only;Lower slowly - feel the side shoulder

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.precautions: Stand tall facing cable, chest up;Elbows high - point them back and out, not down;Rope ends near ears - thumbs toward you at the end;Back stays flat, no leaning/swinging from body
exercises.cues: Set pulley at face height;Pull rope to forehead;Squeeze shoulder blades at the end

exercises.name: Shoulder Rolls
exercises.precautions: Stand or sit tall, arms relaxed at your sides;Roll both shoulders together in big slow circles;Keep your neck long - ears away from shoulders;Shrink the circle if anything pinches
exercises.cues: Shoulders up, back, and down;Big slow circles;Reverse direction halfway

stretches.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
stretches.precautions: Move gently until you feel a mild stretch - never force;Breathe slowly and relax into it - no bouncing;Keep posture tall and supported where you can
stretches.cues: Move gently to a mild stretch;Breathe slowly, never force it
